import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import math
d=pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv",parse_dates=["created"])
days=pd.date_range("2026-09-01","2026-11-30")
k=d[d.shop_id=="KZN-1"]
per_day=k.groupby(k.created.dt.normalize()).size().reindex(days,fill_value=0)
x=per_day.mean()
lam=round(x,2)
obs=per_day.value_counts(normalize=True).sort_index()
exp=pd.Series({j:x**j*math.exp(-x)/math.factorial(j) for j in obs.index})
table=pd.DataFrame({"obs":obs,"exp":exp})
worst_k=(table.obs-table.exp).abs().idxmax()

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
d=pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv")
ok=d[d.actual_min.between(1,299)].copy()
spread=ok.groupby("weather").actual_min.quantile([.25,.5,.75]).unstack()
spread.columns=["q1","median","q3"]
spread["iqr"]=spread.q3-spread.q1
spread=spread.sort_values("median",ascending=False)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
d=pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv")
ok=d[d.actual_min.between(1,299)].copy()
g=ok.groupby("courier").actual_min
q1=g.transform(lambda s:s.quantile(.25))
q3=g.transform(lambda s:s.quantile(.75))
ok["slow"]=ok.actual_min>q3+1.5*(q3-q1)
slow_by=ok.groupby("courier").slow.sum().to_dict()
